'''Weather towers''' were large towers that were used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to manipulate the planet's climate and weather. A number of weather towers were located in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]], [[Alsakan Lowlands]], [[Glarus Valley]], [[King's Pass]], and the [[Apalis Coast]] regions.
